title: Authentic vegan Indian food, made practical
caption:
Big flavours. Practical cooking. 100% plant based. 🌿

Vegan Masala brings authentic vegan Indian recipes, step-by-step technique guides and useful meal planning into one place. From tempering spices to building a proper curry base, we explain why each step matters so you can cook with confidence.

Explore the recipes and guides at vegan-masala.com, follow for more practical Indian cooking, and share this with someone who loves bold food.
